This is an estimate. The after-photo shows the sushi, salad, and toast were essentially all eaten, with only minor residue left. I assumed about 4 small maki pieces (~110 g, ~150 kcal), a salad with light dressing (~120 g, ~60 kcal), and toasted bread (~60 g, ~160 kcal). The drinks add negligible energy unless sweetened.
